name: Push fit plumbing connector removal tool parametric / customizable

captions.detailed: This 3D model is a C-shaped ring tool designed for releasing push-fit plumbing connectors. It consists of a thick, flat cylindrical ring with a central circular opening and a straight, rectangular slot cut out of one side to allow it to slip over a pipe. The outer surface is faceted, and all edges are sharp and perpendicular.
captions.instruction: Create a parametric C-shaped tool for removing push-fit plumbing fittings like SharkBite connectors. The user should be able to adjust the pipe inner diameter, the tool outer diameter, and the overall thickness. The tool must be a solid cylinder with a central bore and a side slot matching the inner diameter minus one millimeter to allow easy clipping onto the pipe.
captions.factory: The script uses a difference() boolean operation to subtract two shapes from a main body. The main body is a cylinder with a radius of outerDiameter/2 and height of thickness. The first subtracted shape is a central cylinder representing the inner diameter (radius innerDiameter/2) translated slightly downward to ensure a clean cut. The second subtracted shape is a cube representing the slot, which is translated and sized to cut out a channel of width innerDiameter-1 from the center to the outer edge.
